name: native-build-shared-daemons
goal: The simulator build never signals Apple's shared compiler daemons, even ones started under it: it waits for them to retire by themselves, fails closed when it cannot observe, and still ends what is privately its own.

evidence: Review blocked 9047420c: ibtoold is shared, so having started one is no right to signal it; ps failure was read as no clients; after 30 s it returned alive and the runner killed it. Expected: no signal ever.

test/ios-build-shared-daemons.test.ts (sha256 1ca5ded1f7496e09), synthetic daemon that journals signals, under runIsolated, against 9047420c: 3 failed (signalled, signalled, returned done). /tmp/harness-shared-daemons-red.log

scripts/ios-build-processes.ts only (sha256 9f18358d8a09d9b9): platform processes are never signalled; under HARNESS_VERIFY they are waited for; unreadable table settles nothing; own leftovers still ended by id and start.
Same unchanged files: ios-build-shared-daemons 3 passed, frozen ios-build-processes (9c196712d6721291) 4 passed. /tmp/harness-shared-daemons-green.log. No Xcode tool was run; no real build repeated.
